name: view_duel_results_titles
description: The duel's results in its own words (design 5.8, contract-m7.md §3), from the simulation's own decision (SimMatch.outcomes() and decided_by(), SimUndertow.decide) on Undertow's rules, one decision after another: the rival's Holdfast falls ('The Tide Took Your Rival', the rule 'Your rival's Holdfast fell on wave 1'), mine falls ('The Tide Took You'), both on one tick ('Even Tide'). Then three duels played through the Surge's last wave, two seats that never build on hollows that play alike (the second seat present but idle), so their lives part only where a setter or a breach parts them: more lives kept wins on 'lives'; level on lives, the side whose uncorked pack breached wins on 'breach' (a Surge window's cork at half price, uncorked by Space, its creeps walked to the rival's Holdfast); level on both is a draw. Each shows its title and rule on the console's end plate or the results plate, whose title, rule line and two blocks (mine first, each with the breach it dealt and its lives) are written out here for the falls, and from the records for the Surge's. Outside a duel there is no duel title.

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a duel against the caretaker

steps.assert: Game.duel_title() == '' and Game.duel_rule_line() == '' and Game.outcome() == '' and Game.sim.outcomes() == []
steps.msg: nothing decided yet

steps.assert: Game.outcome() == 'won' and Game.sim.decided_by() == 'fell' and Game.sim.outcomes() == [0, 1]
steps.msg: the rival's Holdfast fell: won by a fall

steps.assert: node('Hud').end_plate() == ['The Tide Took Your Rival', "Your rival's Holdfast fell on wave 1"] and not node('DriftTray').visible and not node('DuelBar').visible
steps.msg: the console's end plate in the duel's words, and the tray and the bar go

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'THE TIDE TOOK YOUR RIVAL' and node('ResultsRule').text == "Your rival's Holdfast fell on wave 1"
steps.msg: the title and the rule

steps.assert: node('ResultsPanel').team_lines() == ['You 0 breach dealt 20 of 20 lives: Sascha', 'Your rival 0 breach dealt 0 of 20 lives: Edda'] and node('ResultsDetail').text.begins_with('Undertow · 12 waves · ')
steps.msg: a block per side, mine first, with the breach each dealt

steps.assert: node('Team1').find_child('TeamName', true, false).text.to_upper() == 'YOU' and node('Team2').find_child('TeamName', true, false).text.to_upper() == 'YOUR RIVAL'
steps.msg: the heads: you, your rival

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a new duel

steps.assert: Game.outcome() == 'lost' and Game.sim.outcomes() == [1, 0] and Game.duel_title() == 'The Tide Took You' and Game.duel_rule_line() == 'Your Holdfast fell on wave 1'
steps.msg: mine fell: The Tide Took You

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'THE TIDE TOOK YOU' and node('ResultsRule').text == 'Your Holdfast fell on wave 1'
steps.msg: on the plate too

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene)
steps.msg: a new duel

steps.assert: Game.outcome() == 'draw' and Game.sim.decided_by() == 'draw' and Game.sim.outcomes() == [2, 2] and Game.duel_title() == 'Even Tide' and Game.duel_rule_line() == 'Both Holdfasts fell on the same tick'
steps.msg: both on one tick: Even Tide

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene, 1, 1, 'lamplighter', 'lamplighter', false)
steps.msg: a duel of two seats that never build, played to the Surge's last wave

steps.assert: node('Wave').text == 'Surge 3/3' or not node('Wave').visible
steps.msg: the window before the Surge's last wave

steps.assert: Game.sim.decided_by() == 'lives' and Game.outcome() == 'won' and Game.sim.teams[0].lives - Game.sim.teams[1].lives == 5 and Game.sim.hollows[0].phase == 2 and Game.sim.hollows[1].phase == 2
steps.msg: both stood after the Surge: more lives wins

steps.assert: Game.duel_title() == 'The Tide Took Your Rival' and Game.duel_rule_line() == 'You kept more lives after the Surge, %d to %d' % [Game.sim.teams[0].lives, Game.sim.teams[1].lives]
steps.msg: the rule from the records

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'THE TIDE TOOK YOUR RIVAL' and node('ResultsRule').text == 'You kept more lives after the Surge, %d to %d' % [Game.sim.teams[0].lives, Game.sim.teams[1].lives] and node('ResultsDetail').text.begins_with('Undertow · 12 waves and the Surge · ')
steps.msg: on the plate: the duel went through the Surge

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene, 1, 1, 'lamplighter', 'lamplighter', false)
steps.msg: a new duel of two idle seats

steps.assert: Game.surge() == 3 and Game.cork_price(15) == 42 and Game.stipend_gain(15) == 0
steps.msg: the Surge's last window: tier III at half price, no stipend to gain

steps.assert: Game.bottles_of(1)[0]['uncorked'] and Game.sim.stipend(1) == 0
steps.msg: uncorked in the Surge: the stipend does not grow

steps.assert: Game.sim.breach_dealt(0) > 0 and Game.sim.breach_dealt(1) == 0
steps.msg: my pack breached the rival's Holdfast

steps.assert: Game.sim.decided_by() == 'breach' and Game.outcome() == 'won' and Game.sim.teams[0].lives == Game.sim.teams[1].lives
steps.msg: level on lives after the Surge: more breach dealt wins

steps.assert: Game.duel_rule_line() == 'Level on lives after the Surge: you dealt more breach, %d to 0' % Game.sim.breach_dealt(0)
steps.msg: the rule from the records

steps.assert: node('ResultsPanel').team_lines() == ['You %d breach dealt %d of 20 lives: Sascha' % [Game.sim.breach_dealt(0), Game.sim.teams[0].lives], 'Your rival 0 breach dealt %d of 20 lives: Edda' % Game.sim.teams[1].lives]
steps.msg: each side's breach on the plate

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').start(scene, 1, 1, 'lamplighter', 'lamplighter', false)
steps.msg: a new duel of two idle seats

steps.assert: Game.outcome() == 'draw' and Game.sim.decided_by() == 'draw' and Game.sim.hollows[0].phase == 2 and Game.duel_title() == 'Even Tide' and Game.duel_rule_line() == 'Level after the Surge: as many lives kept and as much breach dealt'
steps.msg: level on both: a draw

steps.assert: Game.duel_title() == '' and not Game.is_duel()
steps.msg: a race has no duel title
